name: The Alabaster Box
overview: The Alabaster Box, as depicted in Mark 14:3, represents a profound act of worship and sacrifice, where a woman breaks open a precious container of spikenard to anoint Jesus' head. This event, set in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, highlights the costly devotion and honor given to Christ. The breaking of the box symbolizes the complete surrender and lavish love believers are called to offer, reflecting the anointing and deliverance described in Isaiah 10:27. This narrative invites believers to understand true worship as a heartfelt, sacrificial response to the grace and kingship of Jesus.
